title_sq: Shesim objekt komercial ne Autostraden Tirane-Durres
description_sq:
Shesim Objekt komercial Magazine ne autostraden Tirane-Durres, Vore.
Objekti ka nje siperfaqej trualli prej 4650m2 dhe nje siperfaqje totale ndertimi 1560m2.
Magazina ka siperfaqje 1560m2 e organizuar ne open space pa kolona ne mes me lartesi 11metra.
Per ndertimin e objektit jane perdorur materiale te nje cilesie te larte dhe te gjitha ne perputhje me standartet EU.
Disponon dokumenta te rregullta hipotekore.SPEED129332
title_en: We are selling a commercial building on the Tirana-Durres highway
description_en: We are selling a warehouse commercial building on the Tirana-Durres highway, Vore. The object has a land area of ​​4650m2 and a total construction area of ​​1560m2. The warehouse has an area of ​​1560m2 organized in an open space without columns in the middle with a height of 11 meters. High quality materials were used for the construction of the building, all in compliance with EU standards. Has regular mortgage documents. SPEED129332
